findings.note: Round-2 major fixed by a different, stronger remedy than the exemplar clause: persistent rollout-request/acknowledgement protocol. The set writes the request in the same resource-version-protected Update as the spec bump, so the post-bump observation window cannot look ready; the RBG controller acknowledges only after applying and re-verifying workloads; pending requests exclude the child from readyReplicas/updatedReadyReplicas (no silent RolloutComplete); restart/leader-handover safe; A->B->A fresh counter; missing condition never bypasses an issued request. Also closes the metadata-only window (no generation bump), which the generation-gate exemplar would NOT have covered. Harness-update: R2-F9 was remedy-shaped, updated to a disjunction; mechanism pinned by R3-N1a-h. Verification: previous=fail (round-2 reproduction), head=pass.
